title: Offline Pass
description: Cryptographically signed pass authorizing offline service sessions with spending and usage limits. It belongs to the user (sub) and to that user's device (devicePublicKey) and carries no station and no organization: it is valid at any station that accepts offline passes (spec/profiles/offline/offline-pass.md 2.3).

passId.description: Unique identifier for this offline pass

sub.description: User subject identifier the pass is issued to

deviceId.description: Device this pass is bound to

devicePublicKey.description: The device's P-256 public key, compressed SEC1, Base64 (06-security.md 6.5.2). Its private key was generated in, and cannot be exported from, the phone's hardware-backed keystore; the pass is bound to the device holding it (spec/profiles/offline/offline-pass.md 2 and 6).

keyId.description: Identifier of the server signing key that signed this pass: base64url (unpadded) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of that key (06-security.md 4.3 and 6.7). A verifier selects the key of its server key set that carries this identifier.

expiresAt.description: When this pass expires: issuedAt plus the platform pass lifetime (default 3 days, never more than 10 days; spec/profiles/offline/offline-pass.md 6)

policyVersion.description: Version of the offline policy used to generate this pass

revocationEpoch.description: The platform RevocationEpoch at issuance; a station rejects a pass whose epoch is lower than the platform value it holds (06-security.md 6.6)

offlineAllowance.description: Spending and usage limits for this offline pass

maxTotalCredits.description: Maximum total credits that can be spent across all offline transactions

maxUses.description: Maximum number of offline transactions allowed

maxCreditsPerTx.description: Maximum credits per single offline transaction

allowedServiceTypes.description: WITHDRAWN in 0.25.0 — retained as an accepted-and-ignored member for one transition step only. No validation gate in this specification reads it: not the station's checks (06-security.md 6.1.1), not the authorize-time gate, not the reconcile-time gate. Servers MUST NOT issue it in new passes; stations and servers MUST accept a pass that carries it and MUST NOT reject on its presence, absence or contents. The member is removed outright in a later release, once passes carrying it have left circulation.

constraints.description: Per-pass rate constraint. The station's own offline limits are station configuration, not pass fields (08-configuration.md 5)

minIntervalSec.description: Minimum interval in seconds between consecutive offline transactions

signatureAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used to sign the offline pass

signature.description: ECDSA P-256 base64-encoded signature over the pass fields
